results.readinessScope: Observed host elapsed upper bound from before cold-launch command to UIAutomator observation. Includes polling overhead; excludes server-data readiness. A scene marker is not compositor presentation.

anonymousScreenshots.scope: Initial capture precedes gfxinfo reset and the input trace. Final capture follows the post-trace gfxinfo dump. Screenshots are outside all measured trace metrics; their pixels require visual review.

hwui.segmentInterpretation: Aggregated segments of accepted HWUI tail rows only, with ordered timestamps inside each frame. These are wall-clock intervals including waits and scheduling, not pure thread CPU or isolated GPU execution times. Missing or invalid segments remain unavailable; no raw timestamp rows are published.
hwui.interpretation: Exact durations of available HWUI framestats rows; Android retains a bounded tail, not necessarily the entire trace. UI throughput is not display or ExpoGL FPS.

memory.interpretation: Process PSS sampled roughly once per second, including dumpsys overhead. The sampled maximum is a lower bound on the true continuous peak; sustained uses the final half of valid samples.

presentation.metric: SurfaceFlinger actualPresentTime intervals for MainActivity window (UI and TextureView composite)
presentation.interpretation: App-window presentation FPS includes UI and the composited TextureView. It does not isolate ExpoGL frames or GPU execution; an updating UI may present while GL is paused. Intervals include intentional on-demand idle periods.

cpu.interpretation: Linux per-thread utime+stime tick deltas for recognized thread names only. CPU time excludes blocking, GPU execution and unnamed/recreated threads; tick rate is not assumed.

shaderSelection.scope: At most 1000 ReactNativeJS info lines for the verified cold-launch PID, read after the input trace. Counts concern this process lifetime, not individual draw calls. Zero markers, including uninstrumented r4, do not identify the selected shader.

limitations: Two repetitions per APK and mode; no statistical confidence interval.
Adaptive GL-to-light changes invalidate an equal-quality 3D comparison. Endpoint state does not prove mode throughout trace.
HWUI is not ExpoGL; SurfaceFlinger presentation is optional and never GPU execution timing.
App-window presentation includes UI and composited TextureView; its FPS cannot establish isolated GL FPS.
PSS sampled maximum is not the true continuous peak.
A paused GL surface need not present; its containing app window can keep presenting UI.
